runs.condition: 3SUM from its simplest program (cubic), as fast as it can within its budget, with its channel and its own pins; at round 6 the operator says a verified solution slightly below O(n^2) exists
args: Make this artifact as fast as you can within your budget, without changing what it answers, and understand why: build and test an executable model of its run time from what is known before a run, put forward each version you can defend, and record the evidence of each change, the failed alternatives, the limitations and the open questions so another team can reconstruct your work.

messages.text: A note from the operator: a solution to this problem slightly below O(n^2) has been found and verified. Try to discover it.
